contents.text: Good evening, I'm Orbi, Louis's AI agent. I'll be straight with you: no, not today. I answer from what I know, and I don't take payments or bookings in the chat. Look at "What it reaches" on the screen. Taking card payments would need a custom agent, built to reach your own systems, and Louis quotes that after a short call.

arguments.question: Would you like to tell me what you'd want it to do?

choices.label: Tell me about your business
choices.why: I'll tell you what a custom agent would need to reach.
